_comment: Each provider can now hold MULTIPLE keys, managed from the admin dashboard (Settings > AI Providers) instead of editing secrets.php on cPanel. When a key hits a quota/rate-limit error, chat.php automatically puts it in cooldown and moves to the next key - and if every key for a provider is exhausted, it falls through to the next enabled provider entirely (see etelai_pick_provider / etelai_try_provider_keys in chat.php). cooldown_until is a UTC timestamp string or null.
